visualReview.scope: Portable geometry presentation only; archaeological fidelity is still under review.
visualReview.notes: Inspected all fourteen final portable frames in the labeled contact sheet. Pediment clipping removes duplicate apex vertices; capital volutes now have solid pillow backing, side walls share the same cella limits, and the tile roof has a continuous underside. The twenty-four smooth columns, nine-step stair, open doorway and restored stone silhouette are visible. Carvings are reconstructed motifs and not approved reproductions of the surviving reliefs.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected all thirteen final shared frames and full-size coffer/roof views. One canonical raw basalt graph resolves throughout 1209054 triangles without a private bitmap; unload passes. Roof sky leaks visible in the first pass are closed. Basalt tone, coffer coverage and individual ornament correspondence remain fidelity work. This isolated fixture is not a real-site placement review.

geographicReview.notes: Exact-QID mapped rectangle gives the site anchor and approximate axis. Local +Z is rotated toward the documented northern entrance. Mapped extent is substantially wider than the measured podium. A site rendering must resolve anchor offset, signed stair facing and ground datum before activation.

fidelityReview.notes: Restoration-architect measurements establish the main dimensions; photographs establish smooth drum columns and decorative zones. Exact relief figures, diverse vine/lion motifs, capital profiles, coffer layout, roof pitch/acroteria, restoration stone pattern and site fit remain unresolved. The original paper text was accessible, but its drawing download was declined and no substitute download was attempted. This model is not counted complete.
